text:
Situation: Liraglutide injection remains on FDA's shortage list, first posted 2023-07-18 and updated 2026-10-14. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been listed for 39 months. Corvale East holds two lots totaling 64 syringes (4.4 and 12.1 days on hand). Corvale General holds 62 syringes (14 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows liraglutide injection as a current shortage first posted 2023-07-18 and updated 2026-10-14.

Our position: Current inventory covers less than two weeks at both campuses. The rule-selected option is Biocon Pharma Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place. Four additional suppliers also are not on FDA's shortage list today and their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Biocon Pharma Inc. per the rule-selected option; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Cipla USA Inc., Hybio Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (Pingshan Factory), Lupin Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and NorthStar Rx LLC as backup sources; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and update days-on-hand for both campuses; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Buyer to report allocation limits and lead times from each supplier at the next P&T meeting; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying new purchase orders pending resolution of the FDA-listed shortage.
